speaker: Kai
text: You never ask about it. The mark. Everyone asks. Or worse — doesn't ask, loudly.

speaker: Kael
text: You'd tell me if you wanted me to know. ...Do you want me to know?

speaker: Kai
text: There was a light. A field caught fire. And after that my neighbors stopped looking at me — they started looking around me. Like I was weather.

speaker: Kai
text: You say that like it's easy.

speaker: Kael
text: It isn't. There was a kid, my first year here. Minor house, thin blood, wrong accent. The whole class treated him like furniture. I laughed along for a week before I hated myself for it.

speaker: Kael
text: Gone before winter. So I decided I wasn't going to be that again. Not once, not ever. I'm not easy, Kai. I'm just already done deciding.

speaker: Kai
text: ...Huh. And here I thought you were just too cheerful to notice anything.

speaker: Kael
text: I notice everything. I just refuse to let it win. Same time tomorrow?
